summaries.text: Protecting American Workers Act of 1997 - Amends the Immigration and Nationality Act with respect to the following conditions of H-1B nonimmigrant employment: (1) compensation level; (2) U.S. worker displacement and recruitment; (3)H-1B worker dependence; (4) job contractors; (5) misrepresentation penalties; (6) period of admission; and (7) foreign residence requirement.
